summary: CNFinance Holdings Limited (NYSE: CNF), a Chinese home equity loan provider, furnished a Form 6-K with an earnings release for the first half of 2026. The release covers financial results: total interest and fees income of RMB89.5 million (US$13.2 million), down from RMB415.7 million in H1 2025; net interest and fees loss of RMB88.4 million versus income of RMB143.9 million; operating expenses down ~58% year-over-year; cash recoveries from overdue loans of ~RMB600 million with a 103% recovery rate. No merger, acquisition, tender offer, or other special situation is disclosed. This is a routine earnings announcement for a foreign private issuer.
